# Shared UI (`packages/ui`)

Follow `packages/ui/AGENTS.md`. Preserve exact `base-maia`, Zinc-oriented semantic CSS-variable tokens, Base UI primitives, and shared ownership here. Load `docs/ai/skills/moai-library-shadcn/SKILL.md` for shadcn/registry work. Never run `shadcn init` or switch styles.

For UI lint, authoring boundaries, and consumer checks after shared changes,
use `docs/ai/skills/moai-library-shadcn/references/design-system-lint.md`.
